integrity: The full 36-vertex clique and collapse data, two-complex relator eliminations, and finite-field rank cross-checks are reproducible with the included standard-library Python verifier. The claim is an integral homotopy equivalence established by the CW-disk argument, not a deduction from finite-field homology.
scientific_limitations: Only the 36-vertex graph GP(18,3) with unit-edge vertex metric and inclusive radius two is classified. A prior publication already gave the mod-two Betti numbers at this boundary. Higher radii, other indices, and equivariant homotopy are not classified; an unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
title: Twenty-three integral two-spheres at the sharp \(\operatorname{GP}(18,3)\) radius-two boundary
